reason: A DSH web plugin for microphone-based speech-to-text input, primarily using local FunASR ONNX inference with browser fallback and optional LLM text polishing before composer submission.

summaries.zh: 通过浏览器麦克风将语音转换为文本，优先使用本地 FunASR ONNX 引擎，并支持浏览器回退和可选的 LLM 润色后发送。
summaries.en: Converts microphone speech into text for the DSH web composer using local FunASR ONNX inference, with browser fallback and optional LLM polishing before sending.

capabilities: Captures microphone audio in the browser
Runs local FunASR ONNX speech recognition through a Python sidecar process
Uses the browser Web Speech API as a fallback
Optionally sends transcribed text to a user-configured LLM endpoint for polishing
Automatically inserts and sends recognized text in the DSH composer
